{{Top|leg}}
'''Interloper Eight''' was the callsign of the eighth member of [[Interloper Squadron]], flying a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. In the wake of the [[Battle of Distna]], Interloper Eight used its [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] to tow [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn's]] damaged [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] to safety.
